subject: Renewal and capacity upsell — PO & billing contact update
messages:
From: Alex Taylor <alex.taylor@skylark.ai>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-17T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal + capacity add — PO and billing contact

Hi Logan,

Quick note from procurement at Skylark — we're planning to renew our Redwood commitment and increase our committed capacity from 30k to 50k tokens/month starting 2027-07-01. Procurement needs a formal PO and tax forms to finish the purchase order by 6/01. Can you send your W-9 and legal remit details? Also, please confirm the name to put on the PO and the remit address. Our finance team prefers Net60 terms; is that acceptable?

Also, we would like invoices routed to finance@skylark.ai and the billing contact listed as "Skylark Procurement Ops". If you can share an initial invoice stub and any updated SOW reflecting the capacity increase, we can attach it to the PO.

Thanks,
Alex Taylor
Head of Procurement
Skylark AI
(attachment: none)
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Alex Taylor <alex.taylor@skylark.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-17T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + capacity add — PO and billing contact

Hi Alex —

Thanks for the heads up and congrats on the capacity increase — happy to get this over the line. Attached is Redwood_W9_2026.pdf (our current W-9). A few quick asks so we can generate the correct invoice:

- Legal entity name to show on the PO and the remit address (street + city + tax ID if different)
- Exact billing contact email to appear on the invoice (you mentioned finance@skylark.ai — that works for now)
- Which signer on your side will sign the SOW? We'll need a signed copy for our records.

On payment terms: we typically invoice Net45 for renewals at this seat/capacity tier; Net60 is possible but requires finance approval. I've looped Marcus (finance) to weigh in — Marcus, can you confirm whether we can accept Net60 for Skylark or whether we need to stick to Net45?

I'll prepare an invoice stub and an updated SOW (capacity increase reflected) and send over once I have the PO details.

Best,
Logan Wright
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
(attachment: Redwood_W9_2026.pdf)
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Alex Taylor <alex.taylor@skylark.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-18T08:37:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + capacity add — PO and billing contact

Alex/Logan —

Thanks for looping me in. A couple points from finance:

- Net45 is our standard for renewals at this tier. We can make an exception to Net60 on a case-by-case basis, but that requires approval from our AR director. If Skylark needs Net60, please indicate that explicitly in the PO and we'll start the exception process. Timelines for approval are typically 5–7 business days.

- For invoicing, please include the PO number plus the legal entity name. Also include the remit address and your payment contact. Our remit details (for the invoice) are below if you need to validate:
  - Redwood Inference, EIN: 98-7654321
  - Remit address: 210 Market St, Suite 400, San Francisco, CA 94105

- If you can attach the official PO PDF, we'll attach it to the invoice and SOW when we send the signed copy back.

Monica — can you draft the updated SOW and the invoice stub once we have the PO number?

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Senior Finance Manager, Redwood Inference
(attachment: none)
From: Alex Taylor <alex.taylor@skylark.ai>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-19T14:26:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + capacity add — PO and billing contact

Logan/Marcus —

Thanks for the quick replies. Attached is our official purchase order: Skylark_PO_12345.pdf (legal name: Skylark AI, Inc.; remit: 450 Industrial Ave, Palo Alto, CA 94301). Purchase order explicitly requests Net60, but procurement has confirmed they will approve Net45 for this contract if Redwood requires it — they asked us to note that in the PO so finance can evaluate. Signer on our side will be Priya Desai (Chief Operating Officer).

Billing contact to appear on the invoice: finance@skylark.ai

We still need the signed SOW to close internal approvals; if you can return a signed SOW and an invoice stub, we'll route payment as soon as the PO and signed SOW are in our system.

(attachment: Skylark_PO_12345.pdf)

Best,
Alex
